title: A frozen fixture per schema and a test that reads each
body: tests/schemas/N holds meta.json and records as written by that schema; a test builds a ref from each and checks the chain yields the same records. A bump without a fixture and a step fails the build.
close_reason: tests/schemas/1 frozen; seed_ref builds a ref from a fixture with plumbing; the test reads every fixture and checks the bump on write
